cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: There Is a Process
cards.instruction: Treat every favor, feeling, and urgent need as a request requiring terms, documentation, review, and approval.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I reassure you about the wedding, what precisely am I guaranteeing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fill in the form. Weather, marriage or catering? They have different approval routes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll change the request to 'hug.' One-off or renewable?

reason: A takes the paperwork and adapts to B simpler need while continuing to demand exact duration terms, with no evaluator-facing status phrase.
